seo.title: Enchanting Shillong Day Trip | Kajaawa
seo.description: Discover the charm of Shillong with visits to Elephant Falls, Shillong Peak and other attractions with this one day Shillong trip.

content.text: Dive into the charm of Shillong with this enchanting day tour that lets the travellers explore the city’s best attractions and scenic spots. Witness the best of Shillong by visiting the best spots like Elephant Falls, Shillong Peak, Ward's Lake, Don Bosco Museum and more. This Enchanting Shillong Day Tour offers a blend of relaxation amidst nature, cultural experiences and leisure all in one day.

main.title: Tour Highlights
items: Engage in a day's excursion in Shillong.
Witness the culturally rich Don Bosco Museum.
Visit the amazing destinations like Elephant Falls, Shillong Peak, Ward’s Lake, Botanical Garden.
Witness the splendid Shillong Golf Course and Lady Hydari Park.
Your Shillong One Day Tour starts with exploration of the capital city of Meghalaya, famously known as the ‘Scotland of the East’.

During the tour, you will visit the famous Don Bosco Museum, a place that resembles the rich heritage and traditions of Northeast India. Indulge in witnessing the indigenous communities and their way of life. Travellers can witness the enchanting scenes of Shillong from the Skywalk.

Proceed to the Elephant Falls, one of Shillong’s most visited attractions. This beautiful three-tier falls is given its name after an elephant-shaped rock that once stood near its base and is loved for its natural beauty and peaceful surroundings.

Next, head towards Shillong Peak to get the bird's eye view of the city. From here, you can enjoy sweeping views of Shillong and its lush green landscapes. If the weather is favourable, you may also witness a spellbinding sunset from the top.
Your sightseeing experience further includes a visit to Ward’s Lake, a popular recreational spot known for its serene atmosphere, boating activities, and lovely garden surroundings.
Afterward, set on to the excursion of the Botanical Garden, where you can adore numerous beautiful orchids and other plant species and also spend some relaxing moments surrounded in nature.

Later visit Shillong Golf Course, one of the oldest and largest golf courses in India. This spot is all surrounded by pine trees and rhododendron trees and is indeed a refreshing escape from the busy city life.
Lastly, you will visit Lady Hydari Park, a charming garden filled with colourful flowers. There is also a small zoo where you can witness the best of wildlife.
After a memorable day exploring Shillong’s top attractions, our cab will drop you back at your stay in Shillong, marking the end of your enchanting Shillong Day Tour.
